 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. ESPN college football expert and "College GameDay" personality Rece Davis has ranked his top-10 teams in his latest AP Poll ballot. Davis ranks the Miami Hurricanes as his No. 1 team like most voters in the AP Poll. Miami earned a 38-35 win over the North Carolina Tar Heels over the weekend to remain unbeaten.
 Davis is notably high on the BYU Cougars , who are his No. 2 team. BYU edged past Arizona State in a 27-20 win over the weekend and has a quality win over Notre Dame . However, BYU's overtime loss to UCF is not a good loss. Nobody in the AP Poll ranks BYU higher than Rece Davis.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Davis ranks Notre Dame No. 3 ahead their massive game on Saturday against Miami. Additionally, Davis ranks the Georgia Bulldogs No. 4. The Bulldogs earned a nice win over Florida and play at Ole Miss on Saturday as part of Week 10's stacked slate of games. Davis pushed Indiana down to No. 5 after they needed a 60-yard field goal to force overtime against Minnesota.
 Undefeated Utah and UCLA both remain outside of Davis' top five. Utah faces a major test on Saturday against BYU. Week 10 action has six ranked versus ranked matchups, so there's going to be some carnage and a lot of shuffling in the rankings after Saturday night.
